privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: What this site measures and how

controller.title: Controller
controller.text: Maurizio Rendon, owner of this personal website. There is no public form, email or phone number.

what.title: What is measured
what.text: I use Google Analytics 4 to count visits in aggregate (pages, country, device). No ads and no Google signals: ad personalisation and Google Signals are turned off. For now, the Visits section shows sample data.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage
cookies.text: If you accept, Google Analytics stores measurement cookies ({cookies}, up to {cookieMonths} months) with a pseudonymous identifier for your browser. If you reject, none is stored. Your choice and your motion preference are stored only in your browser (localStorage: {consentKey} and {motionKey}).

region.title: Where consent is asked
region.text: The notice is shown in the EU/EEA, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. To know this, the site asks Netlify for your country (derived from your IP on the fly and not stored). Outside that area measurement is turned on without a notice and no choice is stored; you can still turn it off.

google.title: Google
google.text: Google processes this data as a processor and receives technical data on each visit (IP, browser, language and screen resolution). Data may be transferred to Google servers in the US.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Google Analytics data is kept for {retentionMonths} months and then deleted. Aggregate reports do not identify anyone.

other.title: Your options
other.text: You can change your choice at any time from «Analytics preferences» in the footer or with the button below, and delete the cookies from your browser.
